description: Reset the sub-agent 100-tool-call quiet counter on shell/Python file edits in apps/coder-desktop/page/transcript.coax and add tests.

steps.send: In `apps/coder-desktop/page/transcript.coax`, sub-agents that edit files via shell commands (e.g., Python scripts, `cat <<`, `sed -i`, `tee`, redirection) instead of the structured edit tool were still tripping the 100-tool-call quiet counter. Detect shell/Python file-mutating commands in `transcript.coax` so they reset the quiet counter, and add `#test` coverage in `apps/coder-desktop/page/checks/agents-checks.coax`. Verify with `coax/bin/coax test apps/coder-desktop/page.coax --only agent`.

graders.run: grep -q cp_cmd_edits_file apps/coder-desktop/page/checks/agents-checks.coax && coax/bin/coax test apps/coder-desktop/page.coax --only quiet
